newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Bankar to move into management consulting.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Bankar to move into management consulting.

text.p: Hungary's Bankar financial group will enter new fields of operations by taking up management consulting, the company's officials said on Monday.

"We are starting to operate in management consulting," Bankar's Chief Executive Gabor Kovacs told a news conference. "The essence is that we acquire a minimal stake in companies, one percent or half percent...and we ask for a board seat."

He added that the first expert with whom Bankar would sign an agreement soon was Laszlo Sebesvari, who left the post of General Manager at Petofi printing house, part of Cofinec packaging materials group, in January this year.
Bankar is involved in a number of financial areas, including asset management and currency futures trading.
